feeds.title: reNEWS
feeds.description: Welcome to reNEWS, the 'digital newspaper' and real-time news website tracking the renewable energy market. Established in 2002, the reNEWS newsletter is regarded as a leading source of information on the sector, providing the exclusive and unmissable stories that matter to the industry.

feeds.title: Energy Voice » Renewables/Energy Transition
feeds.description: All the latest news, analysis and expert opinion from the oil, gas and renewables industries.

feeds.title: Recharge
feeds.description: Recharge is the world's leading business intelligence source for the renewable energy industries. We provide award-winning international coverage of breaking news, in-depth features and analysis across the wind and solar sectors. Learn about key energy issues as they happen and get industry insight from our experts.

feeds.title: Sustainable Energy Association
feeds.description: The Sustainable Energy Association is a member-based industry body offering innovative policy solutions that link up building-level technologies and the wider energy system to achieve a low carbon, secure energy future for the UK, benefits for UK consumers, and commercial growth for businesses working in the sector.

feeds.title: Deege Solar Blog
feeds.description: Love Solar Energy? Discover, Learn and Dive In with Our Expert Solar Advice On all Topics Solar and Green Energy Related. Here at Deege Solar we are passionate about creating a sustainable future, and believe that Solar Energy plays a key part in achieving that. As a family-run company we are committed to making Solar Energy accessible and affordable to all.

feeds.title: Solar Energy UK Blog
feeds.description: The Solar Energy UK blog tells about how solar power can benefit the region and the ongoing discussions on implementing solar power as a sustainable form of energy. Solar Energy UK is an established trade association working for and representing the entire solar and energy storage value chain.

feeds.title: Greener Energy Group Blog
feeds.description: Our blog contains information on saving you money with greener energy heating systems. Greener Energy install efficient heating solutions all over Scotland. Greener Energy Group has over 30 years combined experience of providing energy saving solutions to customers, helping them to save money on energy bills and making their home more energy-efficient.

feeds.title: 100% Renewable UK Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog as we talk about how we plan to make UK a place with 100% renewable energy. The aim of 100percentrenewableUK is to campaign for the provision of all UK's energy requirements by renewable energy by the year 2050, or as soon as practicable before then. The campaign is a forum for discussion, education and campaigns for policies on particular issues.

feeds.title: Good Energy Blog
feeds.description: Good Energy provides an insight into the latest renewable energy news and announcements in the UK and abroad. Read more online today. Good Energy was founded over two decades ago to give people a way to be part of a practical solution to climate change.

feeds.title: Carbon Brief
feeds.description: Carbon Brief covers climate science, energy and policy, specialising in clear, data-driven articles to improve the understanding of climate change. We publish a wide range of content, including science explainers, interviews, analysis and factchecks, as well as daily and weekly email summaries of newspaper and online coverage.

feeds.title: REA Blog
feeds.description: Visit the REA Blog and stay up-to-date with the news and press releases from the Association for Renewable Energy and Clean Technology. The REA is a not-for-profit trade association, established in 2001. While the world around us has changed dramatically since we started out, our goal has always been the same: championing our members and promote a future built on renewable energy and clean technology.

feeds.title: Energy Manager Magazine » Renewable Energy
feeds.description: Energy Manager Magazine is your one-stop shop to stay updated on the latest news and analysis about Renewable Energy. Energy Manager Magazine seeks to assist all those working in the Public Sector energy environment, to source ideas, products, services, and solutions to help them in their day-to-day challenges.

feeds.title: Energy Global Magazine
feeds.description: The buzziest renewable energy & industry trends, and events from Energy Global magazine, including solar, wind, bio-energy, and special reports. Energy Global by Palladium Publications is a premier source of technical and analytical information for the renewable energy industry, covering solar, wind, bioenergy, and storage.

feeds.title: Electrifying
feeds.description: Electrifying is a blog founded by Markus Dirnbacher & Michael Bürger to provide useful, critically looked at, and up to date content about the central subject renewable energy, including all different kinds of sustainable energy sources and thereof originating technologies and business opportunities, all with a scientific touch. The Co-Founding Team has always striven for excellence, that will not be any different with their latest project, this blog.

feeds.title: Pure Energy
feeds.description: Pure Energy is UK's Leading Solar Energy Company offering installations, battery storage, PV system upgrades, panel cleaning & maintenance. Pure Energy is a business born out of passion; passion for sustainability and technology. Since being founded we have helped over 1000 homes and businesses in the UK to reduce their carbon footprint, by embracing innovative renewable technologies.

feeds.title: Solar Fast​ Blog
feeds.description: Solar and renewable energy blog! In-depth content with unique research on solar, wind energy and other renewable energy topics.

feeds.title: Project Solar Blog
feeds.description: The Project Solar blog provides tips and advice on how to understand solar power, reducing your energy bills and things you can do to help the environment. Project Solar are the largest and most accredited solar panel installation company in the United Kingdom. We are proud to have installed over 45,000 solar panels and batteries, helping you power your home in an energy-efficient, money-saving way.

feeds.title: Tile Energy UK Blog
feeds.description: Tile Energy Ltd.'s blog aims to be a comprehensive source of information about the latest developments in the industry of renewable energy technologies. At Tile Energy, we challenge, change and improve to create better sustainable energy solutions for our clients. We combine 20 years of technological innovation, insight, knowledge and expertise with an appetite for sustainable energy.

feeds.title: The Renewable Energy Hub Blog
feeds.description: Essential articles and recent news events related to the Renewable Energy Industry. The Renewable Energy Hub is a national organisation that sells and promotes green energy equipment and services. We proudly host the UK's renewable energy forum and largest installer directory.

feeds.title: Carbon Brief
feeds.description: Carbon Brief is an award-winning website dedicated to analysis and fact-checking of energy policy, with a focus on the UK.

feeds.title: RenewableUK
feeds.description: Visit the RenewableUK website and stay updated with the latest news on Renewable energy in the UK. RenewableUK members are building our future energy system, powered by clean electricity. We bring them together to deliver that future faster; a future which is better for industry, bill payers, and the environment.
